name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company that acquires net smelter return royalties on gold properties in Nevada and Idaho. The company operates with a low-overhead model focused on royalty acquisitions rather than direct exploration, with interests including the Lazy Claims, Loman, and Agai-Pah properties in Mineral County, Nevada, and the Lapon Canyon royalty acquired in 2024.
